panels.description: Night at restored Lake Keel in 2099: terraces, gardens, workshops, boathouse, tanker barge and two siphon drones. Older Alex and his granddaughter watch from the dock. Leave upper lake and sky clear for dialogue.
TJ springs from the dock and separates into head, body and magnetic legs above the dark water. Keep every dog-shaped piece readable; leave upper space for lettering.
TJ's separated pieces skim toward the barge while bright columns of stolen water rise from the siphons. Leave open water for sound lettering.
The granddaughter catches older Alex's sleeve as a drone beam sweeps the boathouse. Alex keeps watching the theft. Leave upper dock space.
